preconditions.description: The number of students and the number of clubs are within the specified bounds.
The potential of each student is within the specified range.
Each student is initially a member of a valid club.
The number of days for which the director wants to know the maximum possible strength of the team is within the specified bounds.
The student who leaves their club on each day is within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the maximum possible strength of the team for the i-th day
postconditions.description: The output for each day should be the maximum possible strength of the team, considering the students who have left their clubs.
